ValidationRule.description: Story Verification Gate: blocks Promote and Deploy when the latest verification found issues or failed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Permission.Bypass_Verification_Gate), AND(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = TRUE, OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c))), OR(ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Issues"), ISPICKVAL(Verification_Status__c, "Failed")) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Verification did not pass. Resolve the issues listed in Verification Details and run Verify again before Promote.
